name: dev-orchestrator
description: Thin router for multi-role software delivery. Use when a task spans research, product, engineering planning, backend, frontend, QA, diagnosis, security, monitoring, deployment, Plane, drawing, or roast handoffs; when the user asks what skill should run next; or when broad work must preserve plan-first gates. Use only for routing and handoff sequencing — not for direct execution. Hand off to the chosen specialist skill instead of doing research, planning, coding, testing, or deployment work itself.
